items.q: We make more than one kind of product. Which page do we read?
items.a: The one for your strictest product. A plant with oral solids and one sterile line reads the sterile rows of the pharmaceutical page. A combination product also reads the pharmaceutical page for the drug part. A contract manufacturer reads the CDMO page.

items.q: Do the limits change with the industry?
items.a: No. USP <645>, <643> and <85>, and the Ph. Eur. monographs, set the same PW and WFI limits whoever uses them. What changes is the grade per step, device limits and how the record is audited. Alert and action levels are yours; USP <1231> guides 100 CFU/mL for PW and 10 CFU/100 mL for WFI.

items.q: Our product is not in these four industries. Can you still help?
items.a: If it is a drug, including a natural health product, read the pharmaceutical page. For hospital reprocessing, laboratory or industrial water, see adjacent uses above and send the standard you work to. We will tell you plainly whether it is in our scope.
